title: LoadedSourceIdentity
description:
Initial source identity bound by the actual shared text loader.

Does not resolve legacy IDs or verify fitting provenance/quality. Paths are
not identities and are deliberately absent from this observation.

oneOf.description: Checked experimental typed package and explicit complete level.

level.description: Explicit selected level label; labels are not ModelId preimage data.

model_id.description: Candidate logical identity calculated by the validated reader.

package_id.description: Exact physical package bytes, not logical model content.

oneOf.description: HF execution is supported, but its semantic content hashing is not yet.

reason.description: Explicit unavailable-identity reason; never a synthetic hash/path ID.

oneOf.description: Checked residual-bearing QTEA carrier, not a typed SALT level or semantic ModelId.

declared_source_model.description: Producer's source-model assertion; not authenticated original custody.

package_id.description: Exact physical carrier bytes, including tokenizer assets.

ModelId.description: Content identity for one Tritium model level, not its package or provenance.

PackageId.description: Content identity for a Tritium package.

UnknownReason.description: Standardized reason category for an unresolved claim.

oneOf.description: The claim has not yet been evaluated.
Required hardware or runtime is unavailable.
The producer supplied a reason not represented by a standard code.
